core_rule: Do not use axiom as an operational status label.

notation.CF: candidate fence not yet accepted as derived constraint
notation.MC: machine-safe role code for M(C), the admissible constraint manifold / current survivor surface

layer_model.name: owner thesis possibility space
layer_model.statement: The high-entropy owner model before operational translation: pure randomness, entropy bridge, retrocausal convergence, entropic monism, nominalist identity, survival, spinor/QIT first-survivor, feedback-loop life/mind structure.
layer_model.not_formal_because: No finite carrier, gate, or receipt has been named yet.

layer_model.name: finite translation layer
layer_model.statement: Owner theses are translated into finite fixtures before they can enter gates.
examples: retrocausal convergence -> finite endpoint-conditioned history family
entropy bridge -> finite density carrier plus entropy readout
nominalist identity -> finite probe-relative indistinguishability fixture

layer_model.name: active constraint set
layer_model.statement: The current active root and derived constraints used for admission.

layer_model.name: constraint gate family
layer_model.statement: Finite gates that make constraints operational.

layer_model.name: admissible constraint manifold
layer_model.statement: The current surface of bounded objects and relations that survive active constraints and gates.
layer_model.systems_reading: M(C) is the emergent attractor basin surface of repeated finite, noncommuting constraint pressure. It is not a primitive geometry.

layer_model.name: ratchet transition operator
layer_model.statement: Moves bounded candidates through statuses using gates, receipts, graveyard, and maintenance closure.
layer_model.transition_shape: candidate -> gate -> receipt -> survivor/killed/demoted/blocked -> registry update

llm_rules: Do not call a TH enforceable.
Do not call a CF accepted.
Do not call a PL ontology.
Do not call an EG evidence.
Do not call a SIM successful until it has a REC.
Do not call a REC proof beyond its claim ceiling.
Do not count aliases as new constraints.
Do not use axiom as a status.
Always name the CS form and QIT/math form before sim work.
next_machine_steps: Candidate-gate layer CF14-CF25 is receipted; next admissible step is explicit CF-to-DC review.
Run accepted-DC promotion review before moving any CF-14 through CF-25 candidate into the accepted constraint set.
Keep CF rows outside M(C) until promoted by non-redundancy audit and acceptance review.
Write GR rows for killed candidates and recompute/archive M(C) whenever C changes.

gate_coverage.note: EG row coverage and constraint-target coverage are separate because aggregate gates can enforce multiple RC/DC targets.
gate_coverage.candidate_note: Ungated CF rows are candidate placeholders, not coverage debt against accepted RC/DC constraints.
